senses.gloss:
Khaḍga is the reading in the Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā of the name of an animal which, in the text of the Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, variously appears as khaṅga and khaḍga. The rhinoceros seems clearly to be meant. In the śāṅkhāyana śrauta sūtra a rhinoceros hide is mentioned as the covering of a chariot.
Foot notes iii. 14, 21.
xxiv. 40.
Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 86.
xiv. 33, 26 (khāḍga-kavaca aśvaratha)
